name: GEARS of DRAGOON 2 ~Reimei no Fragments~
original_name: GEARS of DRAGOON 2 ～黎明のフラグメンツ～
source:
Welcome to the enchanting city-state of Carnas, a realm steeped in arcane wonders, governed by skilled magic users. Yet, beneath its cobblestone streets and towering spires lies an unexpected contrast—the Dragonschaft, a labyrinth filled with forgotten technology and mechanical mysteries. This underworld, teeming with monstrous creatures and remnants of an extinct machine-driven civilization, waits silently beneath the bustling life of Carnas.

Meet Rustar, a young adventurer imbued with curiosity. Bearing his father’s final words and a unique talent—the mastery of both magic and machinery—Rustar dares to venture into the depths of the Dragonschaft. His journey takes an unexpected turn when Percy, a fiery young woman wielding an ancient artifact, crosses his path.

With their destinies intertwined, Rustar and Percy delve deeper into the Dragonschaft. The resurgence of a mechanical civilization within its depths disrupts the magical balance Carnas has maintained for centuries. As echoes of a forgotten era stir, so too do the ancient gears of fate, thrusting our heroes into a quest that will forever alter their lives and the course of Carnas.

Prepare for an epic journey in 'Gears of Dragoon: Fragments of a New Era'. Challenge the labyrinth, unlock the secrets of the past, and shape the future of Carnas.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1999870/Gears_of_Dragoon_Fragments_of_a_New_Era/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到迷人的卡纳斯城邦，这是一个充满奥术奇观的国度，由熟练的魔法使用者统治。然而，在其鹅卵石街道和高耸的尖塔之下，存在着意想不到的对比——龙宫，一个充满被遗忘的技术和机械奥秘的迷宫。这个地下世界充满了可怕的生物和已灭绝的机器驱动文明的残余，在卡纳斯熙熙攘攘的生活之下静静地等待着。

来认识一下鲁斯塔，一位充满好奇心的年轻冒险家。带着父亲的遗言和独特的天赋——精通魔法和机械——鲁斯塔敢于冒险进入龙穴的深处。当挥舞着一件古老神器的火热年轻女子珀西横穿他的道路时，他的旅程发生了意想不到的转折。

鲁斯塔和珀西的命运交织在一起，他们深入龙脉。机械文明在其深处的复兴破坏了卡纳斯几个世纪以来所维持的魔法平衡。当一个被遗忘的时代的回声响起时，古老的命运齿轮也随之响起，将我们的英雄推向一个将永远改变他们的生活和卡纳斯进程的追求。

准备好在“龙骑士的齿轮：新时代的碎片”中展开史诗般的旅程。挑战迷宫，解开过去的秘密，塑造卡纳斯的未来。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1999870/Gears_of_Dragoon_Fragments_of_a_New_Era/]Steam[/url]]
